item.description:
1.0.10 — A calmer address bar

  • Clicking the address shows just the address. ⌘T shows a few recent tabs.
  • While typing, only real matches appear — open tabs, a couple of bookmarks and history items, and search.
  • Actions appear only when you type them ("zoom", "pdf", "tidy"…). Type > to see them all.

1.0.9 — Pinned tabs, folders and Tidy

  • Pinned tabs for each space, above a divider (⇧⌘P). They're never archived, and closing one sends it back to its page.
  • Folders, in Pinned or Today: right-click a tab › Add to Folder. Click to open or close.
  • Drag tabs and folders to reorder, into folders, or across the divider to pin and unpin.
  • Tidy: one click groups your tabs into folders by kind of site, with Undo.
  • The icons shared by every space are now called Favorites.
  • No more error beep when using arrow keys on sites like YouTube.

1.0.8 — Autofill

  • The address bar completes as you type, from your open tabs, bookmarks and the sites you visit most. Press Tab or → to take it.
  • If the site is already open, Return switches to that tab (even in another space) instead of opening a duplicate.
  • Backspace stops the completion, so you can search for exactly what you typed.
